description: This PHP file defines a CacheService class responsible for managing cache instances within the OrangeHRM system. It provides a static method to obtain cache objects, which are instances of FilesystemAdapter implementing the AdapterInterface, used for caching purposes.

classes.name: CacheService
classes.description: Provides static access to cache instances with namespace support, utilizing FilesystemAdapter for cache storage.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns a cache adapter instance for the specified namespace, initializing it if not already created.
